snippet.title: Tea, Please! | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Announcing Tea, Please! from Sydney developer Siobhan Willoughby (and her cat, Peanut). This 30-minute slice-of-life title explores the contrast between the drudgery and noise of office life, and the peace and comfort found in remote work during lockdowns – and tea, naturally! You can learn more about Tea, Please! by visiting the game’s official website while you wait for it to brew.

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration  

#frostygamesfest #gaming #indiegames #madeinanz
